claim_summaries: Exact nonnegative work-deficit decomposition over the time-one ergodic components, including temporal strain averaging, active/inactive zero-set contribution, componentwise Ruelle gap, and entropy heterogeneity.
A positive-volume T-invariant region with conditional metric entropy h and volume fraction alpha forces W >= 4 nu V alpha h^2; global zero-set fraction yields W >= 4 nu V H^2/alpha.
Near equality controls L2 distance of local strain to the orthogonal orbit of diag(H,0,-H), with integral squared distance at most 2 Delta.

Positive-entropy exact equality excludes zeros and yields a uniform Anosov flow; after a cover of degree at most four the equality metric is a compact homogeneous Sol or universal-cover-of-SL(2,R) quotient. Dynamical classification overlaps Ghys 1987.
